name: atlasgp
description: Manage ATLAS GP projects and tasks from Claude Code — browse projects, view and create tasks, and log your work without leaving the terminal. Bundles the ATLAS GP MCP server.

atlasgp_url.title: ATLAS GP API URL
atlasgp_url.description: ATLAS GP Cloud is https://api.atlasgp.tech — or your own self-hosted instance URL (e.g. https://atlasgp.yourcompany.com).

atlasgp_token.title: ATLAS GP API token
atlasgp_token.description: An API token (agp_...) generated in your ATLAS GP account settings. Scope it to the minimum permissions and projects the assistant should be able to reach.
